notes:
• Card sorting → Box label layout is now a label designer: tick what goes on the label (order #, box N of N, customer name, phone, game & cards, card count, sort order, status, check-in date, promised date, order notes, store name), move lines up / down, pick each line's size and bold, and add your own text lines with {name}, {order}, {promised}… — the preview updates as you go
• Barcode on the right, left, top, bottom or none
• Small labels like DYMO 30332 (1 × 1 in) get a short barcode (Code 128, 8 digits) that fits and scans; it works in the order search like the UPC
• Giveaway prizes: prizes for finishing a Discord card binder are listed (Card binders), and new kinds of bot prizes show up instead of being hidden
